summary: Gives implementation guidelines for using return codes in MGCP version 1.0 as defined in RFC 3435. Because the return codes cannot cover every situation, the document focuses on helping a Call Agent that receives a code to behave appropriately and consistently. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When a gadget answers with a number, the sender must know what that number means. This guide helps phone systems react to those answer numbers the same sensible way every time.

questions: how should a call agent handle mgcp errors
